observations: Standing gas cooker with four top burners.
Silver body with a black glass oven door.
The brand name 'MAXI' is printed on the top right of the front control panel in photo 0.
Five control knobs are visible on the front panel.
Bubble wrap is placed on top of the burners, and a manual is visible inside the oven.
The cooker is placed on a tiled floor in front of a shop window with 'Electronics' signage.

claims.evidence: The item looks clean and has bubble wrap, but it is not in a sealed factory box.
Dimensions cannot be confirmed from a single photo without a reference scale.
The photo does not show the rear connections or the oven burner in operation to confirm it is not a dual-fuel model.
No distinct single button is clearly visible; this may refer to an integrated ignition system in the knobs.

risks.risk: Burners or oven may not ignite or maintain a flame.
risks.proof: A video showing all four top burners and the oven burner lit simultaneously.

risks.risk: The oven interior may be damaged, rusted, or missing racks.
risks.proof: A photo of the oven door open showing the interior cavity and racks.

risks.risk: Internal gas leaks or faulty valves.
risks.proof: A video of a soap-bubble test on the gas inlet and valves while under pressure.

proof_requests: Video of all four burners and the oven lit and staying on.
Photo of the open oven showing the racks and interior condition.
Photo of the manufacturer's sticker/plate on the back for the exact model number.
Photo of the rear gas connection point.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Maxi brand 4-burner gas cooker. While the 'new' status is unverified, it can be priced as a used unit in good cosmetic condition.
